headline: Evidence, Guardrails and Shared Data
thesis: With few fresh headlines today, the durable signals are Brookings' warning that AI risks outweigh benefits and the push for better data and clearer guidance.
summary: Search coverage was thin today and most of the 11 sources had nothing dated October 28, so this digest leans on recent and evergreen items. The strongest thread is Brookings' January report finding that, on the current trajectory, AI risks to students outweigh the benefits, along with its recommendation of school AI councils. ISTE's rebrand to the International Society for Transforming Education, CoSN's finding that cybersecurity and data privacy top leaders' priorities, and the ADA Title II deadline extension to April 2027 shape the policy and security picture. Ed-Fi's impact stories and its November 9-11 Summit in Nashville anchor the data side.
footnote: Compiled from 11 curated edtech sources · OCTOBER 28, 2026 · Search-snippet based; most sources had no items dated today, so recent or evergreen content is shown.
